answer: Each identity must earn three reuse citations in the lagoon register to claim a reward share. A citation counts only if a paying client reused the work and logged receipt and link; the auditor replays both, and a missing link voids it. Cited work must come from its own orchard, and one orchard entry supports one identity. The k-th fake still needs three fresh reuses, so 1,000 fakes need 3,000 at 40 credits each, or 120,000 credits. A citation ring fails the reef check: a shared payer or client graph collapses its citations to one. An honest agent pays once, with three reuses from work sold.
